tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-18Suppose $(M, g)$ is a Riemannian hypersurface in a Riemannian manifold $(\overline{M}, \overline{g})$, and $N$ is a unit normal vector field along $M$. We say that $M$ is convex (with respect to $N$) if its scalar second fundamental form satisfies $h(v, v) \leq 0$ for all $v \in TM$. Show that if $M$ is convex and $\overline{M}$ has sectional curvatures bounded below by a constant $c$, then all sectional curvatures of $M$ are bounded below by $c$. \end{exercise}
